column1: # dex class-path signatures of mobile ad SDKs, used by tools/adint-phone-inventory.
# Public knowledge; committed. A hit means the string is present in the app's DEX — see the
# limits recorded in docs/step0-method-2026-08-15.md: presence is a CANDIDATE, not an
# observation, and a mediation SDK ships adapters that NAME other SDKs it does not contain.
# The hit COUNT is kept for exactly that reason: an adapter reference and an embedded SDK
# differ by orders of magnitude, and the split between them is calibrated against the real
# corpus once it exists — never against a threshold guessed here.
